title: Backlog workspace-followups-leftovers: Cygwin drive prefix, English check of run lead files in the gate, narrower suite selection for workspace.sh, shared registry loading of the pin checks

tasks.grade_reason: one shell helper branch and test cases that copy existing patterns
tasks.objective: Backlog topic workspace-followups-leftovers items 1 and 4. (a) scripts/lib/workspace.sh rpgf_platform_path maps a WSL-form path to the Git Bash drive form on MINGW, MSYS and CYGWIN, but stock Cygwin mounts drives under the cygdrive prefix (/cygdrive/c/...): on CYGWIN use `cygpath -u` on the Windows form when cygpath is on PATH, else the /cygdrive/<drive>/ form; MINGW and MSYS keep the current drive form; uname is still looked up at call time. rpgf_default_workspace follows through rpgf_platform_path. (b) tests/workspace-default.test.sh: add a negative self-test for the root_default reader guard (a throwaway file with a raw reader in a temporary tree must be reported, a converted reader must not), and make the MINGW netcode-headless case independent of the real Netcode checkout (a temporary workspace fixture with the SGL pin it needs) so it passes on a machine without that checkout. Add CYGWIN cases with a stubbed uname, with and without a stubbed cygpath. Changelog fragment changelog.d/workspace-leftovers-cygwin.md (### Fixed).
acceptance: on CYGWIN the workspace default is the cygdrive form (or the cygpath answer)
MINGW, MSYS and other platforms keep their current answers
the root_default reader guard has a negative self-test
tests/workspace-default.test.sh passes without a real Netcode checkout

tasks.grade_reason: a new gate blocker in the pipeline script; a false positive blocks every PR
tasks.objective: Backlog topic workspace-followups-leftovers item 2. scripts/factory-pipeline.py gate (near the machine-path check of run lead files, function gate) checks run lead files only for machine paths; the English-only rule on docs/plans is caught only by CI (scripts/checks/english-only.py). In the same loop, also check each run lead file read from the integration HEAD with scripts/lib/english.py (first_offending_line, honouring the english-only allowlist the same way scripts/checks/english-only.py does) and add a blocker naming the file, line number and the rule when it is not English. Keep the import of english.py lazy or cheap. Make `status` agree with the gate the same way it does for the machine-path blocker. Tests in tests/pipeline.test.sh: a run lead file with a non-English line blocks the gate with that line; an allowlisted file and an English file do not. Document the blocker in docs/pipeline-cli.md (gate section). Changelog fragment changelog.d/workspace-leftovers-gate-english.md (### Added).
acceptance: gate blocks when a run lead file on the integration HEAD has a non-English line, naming file and line
allowlisted entries and English files pass
status shows the same blocker as gate

tasks.grade_reason: suite selection logic; a selection that is too narrow lets a regression through CI
tasks.objective: Backlog topic workspace-followups-leftovers item 3. tests/run-all.sh sources scripts/lib/workspace.sh, so a change to that helper selects about 55 of 74 suites in `tests/run-all.sh --affected` and in CI (scripts/ci-plan.py uses tests/affected.py). Narrow it the way tests/affected.py already narrows PIPELINE_SUITES: a change to scripts/lib/workspace.sh (and scripts/lib/workspace.py if the same cause applies; measure first with `python3 -B tests/affected.py select-many` on a file list naming it) selects only the suites that name the file or reach it through a script they run (workspace-default, routing, check-registry, netcode-headless, facts, wire-parity and the other real callers), not every suite because the runner sources it. Keep hashes (suite reuse) conservative as for PIPELINE_SUITES. Update the docstring list of rules. Tests in tests/affected.test.sh: a change to workspace.sh selects its real callers and not an unrelated suite (e.g. git-guard); a change to tests/run-all.sh itself still selects what it did before. Report the before and after counts. Changelog fragment changelog.d/workspace-leftovers-affected.md (### Changed).
acceptance: a change to scripts/lib/workspace.sh selects only suites that use it
every real caller suite is still selected
